scenarios.title: Ad Stack Waterfall Performance Analysis
scenarios.description: Analyzing ad stack performance to optimize demand partner sequence and timeout settings
scenarios.query: Our current ad stack has Google Ad Manager as primary, followed by StreamVault Media Publisher Services, then Prebid with 8 demand partners. We're seeing 2.3 second average response times and 78% fill rate. Google fills 45% at $8.50 average CPM, StreamVault Media fills 25% at $6.20 CPM, and Prebid fills remaining 30% at $4.80 CPM. Should we reorder our waterfall or adjust timeout settings? Our page load speed target is under 2 seconds and we need to maintain revenue above $35,000 monthly.

scenarios.title: Audience Segmentation Revenue Impact
scenarios.description: Evaluating revenue impact of implementing granular audience segmentation for floor pricing
scenarios.query: We want to implement audience-based floor pricing across our 500K monthly users. Current data shows: returning users (60% of traffic) have 12% higher CTR, mobile users (70% of traffic) have $2 lower average CPM, users from tier-1 cities (40% of traffic) generate 35% more revenue per session. How should we segment our audience for dynamic floor pricing? What floor price adjustments would you recommend for each segment to maximize overall yield while maintaining 80%+ fill rates?

scenarios.title: Ad Placement Layout Revenue Optimization
scenarios.description: Optimizing ad placement positions and sizes to maximize viewability and revenue
scenarios.query: Our current layout has: header banner (728x90) with 95% viewability earning $15 CPM, sidebar banner (300x250) with 60% viewability earning $8 CPM, in-content native ads with 85% viewability earning $12 CPM, and footer banner with 25% viewability earning $4 CPM. We're considering adding a sticky sidebar ad and moving the footer banner higher up. Based on industry benchmarks and our traffic patterns of 2M monthly pageviews, what layout changes would optimize our revenue per visitor?

scenarios.title: Header Bidding Timeout Optimization
scenarios.description: Balancing header bidding timeout settings to optimize revenue vs page performance
scenarios.query: Our header bidding setup includes 12 demand partners with current 1500ms timeout. We're seeing: 85% partners respond within 1000ms averaging $7.20 CPM, 10% respond between 1000-1500ms averaging $9.80 CPM, 5% timeout completely. Our site speed decreased by 0.8 seconds affecting user experience. Should we reduce timeout to 1000ms to improve performance, and what would be the estimated revenue impact on our $50K monthly programmatic revenue?

scenarios.title: Seasonal Floor Price Strategy
scenarios.description: Developing dynamic floor pricing strategy for seasonal traffic and advertiser demand fluctuations
scenarios.query: Historical data shows our Q4 CPMs increase 40% while Q1 drops 25% compared to baseline. Our current static floor prices are: display $8, video $25, native $12. Last Q4 we had 92% fill rate but may have left money on table. This year we expect 30% traffic increase during holiday season. How should we adjust floor prices monthly from October through February to maximize revenue? Include recommendations for different content categories and device types.

scenarios.title: Mobile vs Desktop Yield Gap Analysis
scenarios.description: Analyzing and addressing revenue per visitor gap between mobile and desktop traffic
scenarios.query: Our desktop traffic (30% of total) generates $2.50 RPM while mobile (70% of total) only generates $1.20 RPM. Desktop users view 3.2 pages per session vs 1.8 for mobile. Mobile ad viewability is 15% lower and CPMs are $3 lower on average. We're considering implementing AMP, adding more mobile-optimized ad formats, or adjusting mobile floor prices. What strategy would most effectively close this $0.90 RPM gap and increase our overall monthly revenue from current $28,000?

scenarios.title: Video Ad Placement Yield Optimization
scenarios.description: Optimizing video ad placement strategy to maximize completion rates and CPMs
scenarios.query: Our video content gets 100K monthly views with current pre-roll ads at $35 CPM but only 65% completion rate. We're considering: mid-roll ads (estimated $28 CPM, 80% completion), post-roll ads ($15 CPM, 45% completion), or outstream video in articles ($22 CPM, 70% completion). Our video content averages 4 minutes length. What combination of video ad placements would maximize revenue while maintaining user experience? Include impact analysis on our current $42K monthly video revenue.

scenarios.title: Advertiser Campaign Brief Submission
scenarios.description: Submit a campaign brief from Advertiser Agent to Agency Agent for reasoning and negotiation.
scenarios.query: I need to submit a campaign brief for Acme Energy's new sustainable solar panel product launch. Our objectives are: build brand awareness among environmentally conscious homeowners aged 35-55, drive consideration for residential solar solutions, and establish thought leadership in clean energy. Budget is $2M for Q1 2025, targeting CTV and online video channels. We require tier_1 brand safety and want a brand lift measurement study. Please coordinate with the Agency Agent to develop a comprehensive media plan.

scenarios.title: Agency Agent Orchestration & AdCP Discovery
scenarios.description: Agency Agent coordinates multi-agent workflow using AdCP Media Buy Protocol for inventory discovery.
scenarios.query: As the Agency Agent for Acme Energy's $2M sustainable energy campaign, I need to orchestrate the complete campaign workflow. First, use AdCP get_products to discover premium CTV inventory from SportsPulse, Apex Sports, and StreamVault that aligns with environmental content. Target sports enthusiasts interested in sustainability. Then coordinate with Signal Agent for audience targeting, Identity Agent for reach estimation, and Verification Agent for brand safety verification before presenting the media plan to the Advertiser Agent for approval.

scenarios.title: Signal Agent Discovery & Activation via AdCP
scenarios.description: Signal Agent discovers and activates audience segments using AdCP Signals Protocol.
scenarios.query: Use AdCP Signals Protocol to discover audience segments for environmentally conscious homeowners interested in sustainable technology. Search for segments from LiveRamp, Oracle Data Cloud, and Experian that match our target: household income $75k+, ages 35-55, interest in clean energy and home improvement. Once identified, activate the best-matching segments on The Trade Desk platform for our Acme Energy campaign. Return the DSP segment IDs for targeting.

scenarios.title: Identity Agent Cross-Device Reach Estimation (MCP)
scenarios.description: Identity Agent provides deterministic reach estimation using MCP protocol.
scenarios.query: Using MCP protocol, estimate the deduplicated cross-device reach for our Acme Energy campaign. We're targeting the 'environmentally conscious homeowners' segment across CTV, mobile, and desktop channels. Calculate household-level reach using UID2 and RampID identity graphs. Provide frequency cap recommendations and privacy-compliant token resolution for our $2M budget allocation across 45 days.

scenarios.title: Verification Agent Brand Safety & Quality Assurance (MCP)
scenarios.description: Verification Agent performs brand safety verification using MCP and alerts.
scenarios.query: Verify brand safety for our Acme Energy campaign placements using MCP protocol. Check the following publisher properties: SportsPulse.com, FoxSports.com, StreamVault environmental documentaries, and streaming fitness content. Apply tier_1 brand safety standards. Flag any properties with brand safety scores below 90 or fraud risk above 5%. If any incidents are detected, prepare an A2A alert for the Agency Agent with investigation details and recommended actions.

scenarios.title: Measurement Agent Brand Lift Study Configuration (MCP)
scenarios.description: Measurement Agent configures brand lift study using MCP and reports results.
scenarios.query: Configure a brand lift study for Acme Energy's Q1 2025 campaign using MCP protocol. Study parameters: measure brand awareness, ad recall, and purchase intent among environmentally conscious homeowners. Use Lucid as the measurement provider with a control/exposed methodology. Budget $8,000 for the study. Once configured, prepare interim and final reports to be delivered to the Agency Agent via A2A protocol with actionable insights on creative performance.

scenarios.title: Publisher Agent Media Buy Creation & Delivery (AdCP)
scenarios.description: Publisher Agent creates media buy packages and tracks delivery using AdCP Media Buy Protocol.
scenarios.query: As Publisher Agent for SportsPulse Premium CTV inventory, process the incoming media buy request from Agency Agent using AdCP Media Buy Protocol. Create a media buy package for Acme Energy with: $500,000 budget allocation, premium sports documentary placements, 30-second video format, tier_1 brand safety, and environmental content alignment. Confirm creative deadlines, provide delivery projections, and set up real-time delivery tracking. Return the media_buy_id and package confirmation.

scenarios.title: Complete Agentic Campaign Flow Integration
scenarios.description: End-to-end demonstration of all seven agents coordinating, AdCP, and MCP protocols.
scenarios.query: Execute the complete agentic advertising workflow for Acme Energy's $2M sustainable energy campaign: 1) Receive campaign brief from Advertiser Agent (A2A), 2) Discover inventory via Publisher Agent (AdCP Media Buy), 3) Find audience segments via Signal Agent (AdCP Signals), 4) Estimate reach via Identity Agent (MCP), 5) Verify brand safety via Verification Agent (MCP), 6) Configure measurement via Measurement Agent (MCP), 7) Present media plan to Advertiser Agent for approval (A2A), 8) Execute campaign via Publisher Agent (AdCP). Coordinate all agents and report status at each step.

scenarios.title: Agency-Publisher Rate Negotiation
scenarios.description: Agency and Publisher Agents negotiate premium inventory rates using.
scenarios.query: Initiate A2A negotiation with Publisher Agent for premium Pro Football League Playoff inventory. Our Acme Energy campaign needs 50M impressions during the playoff window, but current CPMs of $48.90 exceed our $42 target. Propose a volume commitment deal: guaranteed $1.2M spend in exchange for $42 CPM floor and first-look rights on environmental documentary inventory. Include brand safety guarantees and delivery commitments in the negotiation.

scenarios.title: Verification Agent Incident Alert & Investigation
scenarios.description: Verification Agent detects brand safety incident and escalates via.
scenarios.query: ALERT: Brand safety incident detected on StreamVault placement for Acme Energy campaign. A video in our environmental documentary targeting was flagged for controversial climate content that conflicts with brand guidelines. Current brand safety score dropped from 96 to 78. Prepare A2A incident report for Agency Agent including: incident details, affected impressions (estimated 125,000), recommended immediate actions (pause placement, exclude content category), and investigation timeline. Request acknowledgment and escalation decision.

scenarios.title: Measurement Agent Interim Results Report
scenarios.description: Measurement Agent delivers interim brand lift results.
scenarios.query: Deliver Week 2 interim brand lift report for Acme Energy campaign to Agency Agent. Results show: +28% brand awareness lift (target: 25%), +18% ad recall (target: 20%), +12% purchase intent (target: 15%). Key insight: 30-second creative format showing 2x lift compared to 15-second spots. Environmental documentary placements outperforming sports content by 34%. Recommend budget reallocation from sports to documentary inventory. Request Agency Agent feedback on optimization recommendations.

scenarios.title: ARTF Container Bid Enrichment Flow
scenarios.description: Identity and Verification Agents enrich bid requests via ARTF containers in exchange infrastructure.
scenarios.query: Explain the ARTF (Ad Request Transform Framework) container flow for real-time bid enrichment. When a bid request enters the exchange: 1) Identity Container adds UID2 tokens, RampID, household_id, and device_count for cross-device targeting, 2) Verification Container adds brand_safety_score, ivt_risk (fraud detection), and viewability_prediction. Show how these enriched signals flow to DSPs for better targeting and brand safety decisions. This is infrastructure-level processing, not direct agent communication.

scenarios.title: Advertiser Agent Media Plan Approval
scenarios.description: Advertiser Agent reviews and approves media plan from Agency Agent
scenarios.query: Review the media plan submitted by Agency Agent for Acme Energy Q1 2025 campaign. Plan includes: $2M total budget, 60% CTV ($1.2M), 40% online video ($800K), targeting environmentally conscious homeowners 35-55, tier_1 brand safety, brand lift study included. Projected reach: 2.1M households, 78% match rate, estimated +25% brand awareness lift. Evaluate against our objectives and brand guidelines. Provide approval decision with any modifications or clarifying questions via A2A response.

scenarios.title: Signal Agent Segment Performance Analysis (UCP, MCP)
scenarios.description: Signal Agent analyzes activated segment performance and recommends optimizations.
scenarios.query: Analyze performance of activated audience segments for Acme Energy campaign after Week 1. Segments activated: lr_exp_homeowners_eco (LiveRamp), oracle_green_tech_intenders, experian_solar_considerers. Compare conversion rates, CPAs, and brand lift contribution across segments. Identify top-performing segment for budget reallocation. Recommend new lookalike segments to test based on converter profiles. Prepare optimization recommendations for Agency Agent.

scenarios.title: Publisher Agent Delivery Tracking & Optimization
scenarios.description: Publisher Agent tracks media buy delivery and provides pacing recommendations.
scenarios.query: Provide delivery status for Acme Energy media buy (media_buy_id: mb_acme_q1_2025) using AdCP get_media_buy_delivery. Current status after Day 15 of 45-day campaign: Check impressions delivered vs. target, pacing status, completion rates by placement, and brand safety compliance. If under-pacing, recommend inventory reallocation. If over-pacing, suggest budget optimization. Include viewability metrics and any delivery issues requiring Agency Agent attention.

scenarios.title: Agency Agent Budget Reallocation Request
scenarios.description: Agency Agent requests budget reallocation approval from Advertiser Agent.
scenarios.query: Based on Week 2 performance data, I'm requesting budget reallocation approval from Advertiser Agent. Recommendation: shift $200K from sports content (underperforming at 0.8% CVR) to environmental documentaries (outperforming at 1.4% CVR). This reallocation is projected to improve overall campaign CPA by 18% and increase brand lift by 6 percentage points. Measurement Agent data supports this recommendation. Requesting approval within 24 hours to optimize remaining campaign flight.
